plan.scope: Warm whole resolveHit including equal per-hit reset and rider setup; excludes loading, rendering and world timers. Retained heap after forced GC is not total allocation. Desktop measurements are not device acceptance.

benchmark.scope: Warm whole resolveHit including equal per-hit reset and rider setup; excludes loading, rendering and world timers. Retained heap after forced GC is not total allocation. Desktop measurements are not device acceptance.

validationRepairs: The guise ordering test now distinguishes first-hit and repeated-hit state; the original second-call assertion incorrectly expected an unbroken guise.
The fused-bypass test counts lookups instead of throwing a generic sentinel, so the mutation is rejected by a behavioral assertion.
The overlay control edits the exact parsed tail/signature instead of a similarly named earlier statement.
The existing voice source census follows the moved disguise caption into hitPreparation.ts without changing any assertion; the rejected first game run is retained.
The balance source comparison excludes timestamped smoke-report outputs while comparing every other balance file.
performanceAcceptance: Desktop whole-hit observation only; no general speedup, total allocation-volume or Steam Deck/mobile acceptance.
scope: Preparation through guard/shell admission and synchronous game continuation. Fuse execution, native interception implementations, hit aftermath/death/delivery, dedicated engine packages and physical-device optimization remain open.
